notes: New: a design simulator (More › Design simulator). Draw a data system with 37 parts, including Kafka, CDC, Spark, Airflow, dbt, quality checks, schema registry, dead-letter queue, lake, warehouse, OLAP, feature and vector stores and an LLM. Run traffic and watch throughput, p99, errors, lag and monthly cost.
Break it: 19 failures, such as a crashed database, a zone outage, a hot partition, bad records, a breaking schema change, a cache stampede or a slow partner API.
16 challenges tied to your modules (Kafka partitions, CDC catch-up, serving reads, failover, cost, RAG under a rate limit). Each starts broken; fix it until Check my design passes. Passing earns XP.

Find them where you study: on module chapters and labs, after module quizzes, in the System design studio, as a challenge card on Today, and as Sketch it in the simulator on live mock design questions.

Quick start on iPhone: one tap opens a ready streaming, batch, CDC, serving, analytics or RAG design to edit by touch. Designs save as you go, sync across devices, and export as JSON, a picture or a share link.
